title: Software Engineering Intern (Summer / Fall 2026)
description: Join our product engineering team as a Software Engineering Intern. You will work alongside experienced mentors to develop user-facing features, write automated tests, and contribute to real-world production codebases.
responsibilities: Develop and test clean, maintainable code for core features under the guidance of senior mentors.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in daily agile standups, sprint planning, and code reviews.
Participate in building internal developer tools and customer-facing web components.
Troubleshoot, debug, and write unit tests to ensure high code reliability and performance.

title: AI & Machine Learning Research Intern
description: Exciting internship opportunity in generative AI and machine learning. You will assist our AI research team in data preprocessing, fine-tuning evaluations, prompt engineering, and LLM benchmarking.
responsibilities: Prepare, clean, and tokenize domain datasets for model fine-tuning and evaluation.
Conduct systematic benchmark evaluations across open-weight LLMs and RAG pipelines.
Document experimental outcomes, accuracy metrics, and inference latency statistics.
Collaborate with AI researchers to implement prototype algorithms and visualization scripts.

title: Data Analytics & Business Intelligence Intern
description: Looking for an analytical Data Analytics Intern to query relational databases, perform exploratory data analysis, and build executive reporting dashboards for product and business teams.
responsibilities: Write SQL queries to extract, transform, and aggregate customer and operational dataset.
Design intuitive Tableau/PowerBI visual dashboards to track core product KPIs.
Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, anomalies, and user behavior patterns.
Present quantitative insights to product managers with clear visual charts.

title: Frontend UI/UX Web Development Intern
description: Passionate about creating modern, responsive web experiences? Join us as a Frontend Intern to turn Figma designs into interactive, accessible React components and web applications.
responsibilities: Translate Figma UI/UX wireframes into responsive and accessible React components.
Connect client-side interfaces to backend REST APIs using modern fetch/Axios patterns.
Fix visual layout bugs and ensure cross-browser compatibility across mobile and desktop.
Participate in weekly design reviews and engineering standups.

title: Graduate / Fresher Software Engineer (Full Stack / Java / React)
description: We are hiring passionate recent university graduates and freshers for our Associate Software Engineer program. You will receive dedicated mentorship while building scalable customer-facing software.
responsibilities: Design, write, and deploy full stack web features with high code quality standards.
Develop and consume RESTful microservices and write efficient relational database queries.
Participate actively in agile sprint cycles, daily standups, and peer code reviews.
Write unit and integration tests to ensure software reliability and security.

title: Junior / Fresher Frontend Developer (React, Next.js, Tailwind)
description: Looking for an energetic Junior / Entry-Level Frontend Engineer to build intuitive, fast, and accessible user experiences with React, TypeScript, and modern CSS tooling.
responsibilities: Build modular, reusable React components with responsive layouts across all screen sizes.
Integrate backend REST endpoints, handling loading, error, and optimistic UI states.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement pixel-perfect visual interactions.
Optimize web page load speeds and adhere to accessibility guidelines (WCAG).

title: Junior / Fresher Backend Engineer (Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL)
description: Join our backend infrastructure team as an entry-level backend engineer. You will construct RESTful APIs, manage relational database schemas, and optimize server-side logic.
responsibilities: Develop secure, well-documented REST APIs with authentication and validation layers.
Design database tables, indexes, and write performant SQL queries.
Write automated integration tests using Jest and Supertest to validate API behavior.
Collaborate with frontend engineers to deliver unified end-to-end product features.

title: Graduate QA & Software Test Automation Engineer (SDET)
description: Kickstart your career in software testing and automation. Work on test strategy, write automated UI and API test scripts, and uphold product quality across web applications.
responsibilities: Write and execute comprehensive manual test cases and automated regression suites.
Automate end-to-end browser workflows using Playwright / Cypress / Selenium.
Test REST APIs for schema compliance, response status, and edge-case handling.
Log detailed bug tickets with steps to reproduce, logs, and screenshots.

title: Associate Cloud & DevOps Operations Engineer
description: Great opportunity for tech enthusiasts wanting to build skills in cloud architecture, Linux administration, containerization, and automated CI/CD deployments.
responsibilities: Assist with configuring and maintaining Linux cloud servers and containerized apps.
Build and troubleshoot GitHub Actions workflows for continuous integration and delivery.
Monitor application logs, server health metrics, and alert triggers.
Maintain developer documentation for environment setup and deployment routines.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React, Node.js, TypeScript, Cloud)
description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to lead end-to-end web architecture, scalable microservices, and interactive client applications.
responsibilities: Architect and scale modern web applications serving millions of users.
Design fault-tolerant backend microservices and optimize SQL/NoSQL queries.
Collaborate with product managers and designers to deliver intuitive user interfaces.
Lead code reviews, establish testing automation, and mentor junior engineers.

title: Machine Learning & AI Engineer (LLMs, Python, PyTorch)
description: Looking for an AI/ML Engineer to train, fine-tune, and deploy foundation models, RAG pipelines, and high-throughput inference APIs.
responsibilities: Build generative AI pipelines, vector retrieval mechanisms, and custom agentic workflows.
Optimize inference latency and fine-tune open-weights LLMs for domain-specific tasks.
Implement robust evaluation metrics, guardrails, and data preprocessing pipelines.
Collaborate with backend teams to integrate AI models into production microservices.

title: Frontend Engineer (React 19, Modern CSS, Performance)

responsibilities: Develop responsive, pixel-perfect web interfaces with sub-second load times.
Ensure web accessibility (WCAG AA) compliance and cross-browser consistency.
Maintain and expand our core component library and design system.
Optimize core web vitals and client-side rendering bottlenecks.

title: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Architect (Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform)
description: Drive cloud infrastructure automation, observability, multi-region high availability, and secure CI/CD deployment pipelines.
responsibilities: Manage Kubernetes clusters and automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform.
Build zero-downtime deployment pipelines and multi-environment GitOps workflows.
Monitor application performance, uptime (99.99%), alerting, and incident response.
Enforce cloud security baselines, IAM policies, and cost governance.

title: Data Scientist (Statistical Modeling, SQL, Predictive Analytics)
description: Derive actionable business insights, design statistical experiments, and build predictive machine learning models.
responsibilities: Analyze massive customer behavioral datasets to uncover growth and retention drivers.
Design and evaluate statistical A/B tests with strict significance thresholds.
Build and maintain production predictive models for churn, recommendation, and forecasting.
Communicate statistical findings to executive stakeholders through visual executive summaries.

title: Technical Product Manager (SaaS, Roadmap, Agile, Analytics)

responsibilities: Define product vision, quarterly roadmaps, and measurable OKRs.
